create_models_management_client: create a ModelsManagementClient to manage models on a LiteLLM proxy server
list_models_management_client: list all models supported by the LiteLLM proxy server
create_new_model: create a new model on the LiteLLM proxy with name, params, and optional model info
delete_model: delete a model from the LiteLLM proxy by its model ID
get_model_info: get detailed information about a specific model by ID or name
update_model: update an existing model's configuration on the LiteLLM proxy by its ID
